purpose: Prevent third-party listing data from being durably persisted to the public repository unless source rights are explicitly cleared in project governance.
principles: public availability is not equivalent to redistribution permission
research collection eligibility is not equivalent to public repository persistence eligibility
license review required must fail closed for public repository persistence
a source may be enabled only through an explicit reviewed policy change
local ephemeral QM tests do not imply any broader data-use or redistribution right
